Results.ReviewText: Nice grill .  Good ash catching mechanism on the bottom.  Has not changed over the years which is a great feature. The only thing I would add is that the legs are flimsy and could use a design change to make them a little more stable.
Results.Title: My new grill

Results.ReviewText: I works fine and I like the thermometer, but it needs a second handle.  My old one had one.
Results.Title: OK but another handle would make it perfect

Results.ReviewText: I was disappointed that the enamel on the outside of my kettle started to peel. I contacted customer support to find a possible cause. I was surprised to hear my kettle was still under warranty. ( I've owned it 8 yrs.) Weber replaced the bottom of my kettle free of charge. However, I still haven't been told of a possible cause and my old kettle had 2 handles and the new one only has 1. The second handle makes it easier to move when its hot.
Results.Title: Enamel degradation on kettle

Results.ReviewText: Great grill and with so many youtube videos it can cook practically anything. Wish I had purchased one sooner.
Results.Title: Perfect grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought this for my husband’s birthday and he loves it. He has the same one in gold I bought him for Father’s Day a few years ago that he uses several times a week and for smoking meat. He is happy he can use one for smoking and the new grill for his regular grilling! These grills are high quality and will last you for a long time.
Results.Title: Husband loves his new grill!

Results.ReviewText: First charcoal grill I have owned.  Works great, well made and easy to assemble. Highly recommended.
Results.Title: Great grill.

Results.ReviewText: Wanted a grill that does it all with simplicity. With the grill accessories, charcoal is ready to cook in 20 minutes for direct or indirect grilling.
Results.Title: Great design, Great BBQ Results

Results.ReviewText: Have really loved this grill! First time doing much charcoal grilling and have really enjoyed the ease all the way around of this grill!
Results.Title: Fantastic!

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback is very important to us. We are sorry to hear about your disappointing experience and sincerely apologize for the inconvenience it has caused. Your satisfaction is our top priority, and we want to make this right for you. Please look for an outreach email from our Care Team soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: Why would I comment when I feel I need a lawyer to understand the Customer Review Policy?
Results.Title: No Comment

Results.ReviewText:
It was time to replace my old Weber 22 inch premium kettle that was 16 years old. I bought a new equivalent model in copper. Very nice finish. Quality seems to be equal to the old grill, should last a long time.

Some differences between the old and new version:

New version has a thermometer.

The hook on the inside of the lid is smaller, making it difficult to hang the lid.

The new grills ash collector is harder to remove and reattach.
Results.Title: Still a quality grill

Results.ReviewText: Love it, I’ll never go back to Gas grilling again!  Chicken thighs, skin down, Adobo Sazon, Creole seasoning, vents all the way open cover for 35 minutes, open and flip chicken, brush with your favorite barbecue sauce. Let cook for 12 more minutes or until temperature is 170.
Results.Title: That charcoal smell really reels you in!

Results.ReviewText: My first one, the wheel just rusted off after 20 years!  For my birthday my friend bought me the 22” indigo.  It’s beautiful and works wonderfully!
Results.Title: Indigo Baby

Results.ReviewText: Bought this after my last Kettle, it lasted 20 years and was still I operable when i passed it along.  I hope this one will give me similar service.  I use it for both direct and indirect cooking.  I love the flexibility.  My only concern is not having two handles on the kettle portion of the grill.  It does make it easier to move with two.  I bought this grill in the copper color and I love how sharp it looks!  From burgers and steaks to seafood, veggies and whole chickens and tenderloins, this grill does it all!  And you cannot beat the flavors.
Results.Title: The Original!  22" Kettle

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill. So far we have made delicious steaks, whole chicken and of course brats, and burgers. Love the simplicity of it and the size is perfect for our family.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: I purchased our Weber for my husband to replace the old one. He loves his Weber and would not change as he is now 75.
Results.Title: Best Weber ever

Results.ReviewText: Works great.  I like that my dog can't eat the ashes out the of bottom of the grill because it is completely covered.  The heat deflector is nice so the handle of the cover doesn't get too hot to touch. They'll get the 5th star when the handle is put back on the other side of the grill, so you can carry the grill even if it is hot.
Results.Title: Almost fixed all of the issues

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear you received the grill with loose grates and scratches. Your satisfaction is our top priority, and we are here to help. Please look for an outreach email from our Care Team soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: Came with grates loose, scratches on enameled surfaces.
Results.Title: Inferior welding, grates loose on end flaps.

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for being a long-time Weber grill owner! We're saddened to hear of your disappointment in the quality and customer service. Our team would like to reach out to you to demonstrate our ongoing commitment to providing outstanding assistance to our loyal fans.

Results.ReviewText: I have had Weber grills since the 1980s.  This is the first one that doesn't live up to the reputation for quality. Customer service has gone from excellent to poor in less than one year.
Results.Title: Not what it used to be

Results.ReviewText: This was a gift for my husband's birthday!  He loves it! Has used it quite a bit since we gave it to him! Everything has tasted great!
Results.Title: Great gift!

Results.ReviewText: I love my grill. Easy to use and I love food cooked with charcoal.
Results.Title: Weber Original Kettle

Results.ReviewText: The Weber charcoal grill is outstanding — classic design, solid construction, and unbeatable performance. It heats up quickly and holds temperature beautifully, making it ideal for both high-heat searing and slow cooking. The airflow system is intuitive and allows great control over the flame. Cleanup is a breeze thanks to the ash catcher. It delivers that rich, smoky flavor every time. A must-have for any grilling enthusiast!
Results.Title: Fantastic!

Results.ReviewText: I've been using Weber products for years. The quality has been nothing but outstanding. My current Kettle was a Fathers day gift and will provide great family memories for many years to come. I highly recommend Weber products.
Results.Title: Always quality products

Results.ReviewText: Wonderful grilling experience. The ash catcher is nice. This color is great!
Results.Title: Excellent looking and excellent grilling

Results.ReviewText: Best grill I ever had.  Was easy to assemble and easy to use.
Results.Title: New Grill

Results.ReviewText: I have a gas grill, an electric smoker, a pellet grill, and now, a Weber Original Kettle Premium 22" Charcoal Grill. I could have saved a lot of money, and space, and just bought the Weber Kettle first. It does everything the others do, with better results. You just can't beat the charcoal flavor, and throwing on a few wood chunks makes it even better. I'm also saving time. My latest pork butt was done in 7 hours, my latest ribs in about 4 hours. Both were the best I have ever cooked. On my pellet grill or smoker I usually take almost twice as long, and the Weber tastes way better. Using charcoal and real wood chunks also brings out my inner caveman- it is much more satisfying to use than my other grills!
Results.Title: My New Favorite Grill!

Results.ReviewText: Haven't had one of these kettles at my home for a long time and wish I would have bought it sooner. Great addition to the back patio
Results.Title: Mean green grilling machine

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill! Just the right size for 2 people!
Results.Title: Love it!

Results.ReviewText: This is my third Webber. I started with a small grill in my early days. Upgraded to a 22” over 20 years ago. As the rivets that hold the legs to the body finally gave out after thousands of uses. I love the upgrades to the grill over the years. I expect another 20 plus years of use from this grill.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText:
Terrific grill, eazy clean up
For tall people it is a little low but we make due.
Results.Title: A1A Florida Grilling

Results.ReviewText: I own many weber grills and continue to be a huge fan of their products.  The kettle is very versatile.  I can grill, bbq and smoke all on this kettle.  I also really like that Weber stands behind their products with a great warranty and awesome customer service.
Results.Title: Great product

Results.ReviewText: I watched several YouTube videos before using my new Weber grill.  It worked exceptionally well.  I used the wax melts under the chimney starter and everything worked well.  It was very easy to use and would recommend it.
Results.Title: Weber charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: We grilled steaks, burgers and the made s’mores EXCELLENT
Results.Title: VERY TASTY!

Results.ReviewText: Love the clip on bracket to the grill..works great.
Results.Title: Wish you redesigned the hooks to clip like this.

Results.ReviewText: I really like this grill………………………………….    Xxxxxxxxx
Results.Title: N/A…

Results.ReviewText: This is my 2nd Webber Kettle grill. I had my 1st one 25 years and I gave it away when we moved. When I opened my new one, I found a chip in the paint on the lid. I was afraid it would get worse. I almost took it back to the store, but before I did, I went on Weber’s website. I chatted with a service rep. She asked me for a photo of my receipt and a photo of the chip on the lid. Within a few hours, I was notified that a new lid was on its way. That’s great customer service! Thankyou.
Results.Title: Great Customer Service Experience

Results.ReviewText: I truly enjoy this grill. I’ve used it 2-3 times every week and I’ve learned how to smoke meats on it using the snake method. It’s easy to clean and has a thousand uses. I really love this grill.
Results.Title: Best Fathers Day present!

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear about the damage to the grill handle and grate. Our Care Team will reach out to ensure this issue has been resolved. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: I would give this no stars if I Could. I ordered this grill brand new for fathers and the grill handle and grate are bent. The grill bowl which I thought the copper color would be nice came scratched … I asked for replacement parts and still have not recieved a replacement grate.
Results.Title: Disappointed

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
